## 1. Prediction market

89 days from the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) held near the cycle peak. **Lula** remained stable at 61.50% (USD 7.24M) and the gap over **Flávio** rose slightly to +39.30pp, just 0.25pp from the record of +39.55pp on July 3. Flávio fell back to 22.20% (USD 7.25M). On a day of strong adverse news flow for the senator, the price barely moved, a momentum move rather than a reaction. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market totals USD 110.9M.

In the third way, **Renan Santos** stood at 9.70% (USD 7.89M) in the [winner market](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election), still below 10%, but expanded favoritism to 3rd place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), to 67.0% (USD 129k). It is the largest individual volume in the presidential market, a signal of real money concentrated on a name that polls measure at 2-4%. The others remained at floor: **Michelle Bolsonaro** 1.50% (USD 8.69M), **Camilo Santana** 1.15% (USD 3.81M), **Zema** 0.95% (USD 4.28M), **Caiado** 0.90% (USD 4.74M) and **Haddad** 0.85% (USD 6.13M).

In the [sub-market for 2nd place in the 1º turno](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place), **Flávio** expanded to 81.5% (USD 151k), the highest level of the cycle, reinforcing his status as Lula's certain opponent, ahead of Renan (10.5%, USD 1.03M). In the [Senate market by number of seats](https://polymarket.com/event/next-brazil-senate-election-most-seats-won), [PL](/en/glossary#pl) remained isolated leader with 87.5% (USD 250k), versus [MDB](/en/glossary#mdb) at 11.3%, a sign of institutional reach for the party.

On the institutional side, the [market for impeachment of an STF minister before 2027](/en/glossary#stf) remained stable at 2.8% (USD 82k), at floor level, even with the Master case active and the new [PF](/en/glossary#pf) front against Flávio. On **2026 inflation**, the band from 5.00% to 5.49% led with 32.9%, followed by the range 4.50% to 4.99% with 28.4%, a consensus of controlled inflation around 5%.

## 2. What the institutes recorded

There was no new national presidential poll on July 7. The dashboard base follows the [AtlasIntel of July 1](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) ([first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) Lula 46.3% x Flávio 36.6%; [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 48.8% x 42.3%), the last national published, alongside [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) from fieldwork June 17-19 ([second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 47% x 43%) and BTG/[Nexus/BTG Pactual](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) from June 29 ([second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) 47% x 44%, [empate técnico](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico)). The national picture, therefore, did not change due to poll data, but rather due to news flow.

On the state level, [Datafolha released the Senate race in São Paulo](https://news.google.?oc=5), with Marina Silva at 18%, Tebet at 16% and Ricardo Salles at 13%, a reading that matters to ticket dynamics but not to national presidential race. [Gazeta do Povo published scenarios with substitutes for Flávio](https://news.google.?oc=5), a stress test of the third way should his candidacy stumble.

The next national vote test is the [Gerp poll, scheduled for tomorrow](https://news.google.?oc=5).

## 3. What the press covered

The day's focus was the external damage to Flávio Bolsonaro. The senator [testified at a USTR hearing in the United States](http://www.em.com.br/politica/2026/07/7456729-pior-momento-flavio-diz-nos-eua-que-tarifas-ajudariam-lula.html) about the 25% tariff against Brazil, arguing that the measure would help Lula and that this is the "worst moment" to adopt it, and defended Pix as a system that also benefited American companies, according to [BBC News Brasil](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9FbFVCSTZrdUVpbF9qY3duMkZTMnpkM09SNGJha00yUjBOZlZIZWoxRUtiM2NlTGRKcVJKSkZoRjNWSHhrUFZOaFd2bWY5enR5aFlPZE83VnpYUVNlN2xwbDVB0gFnQVVfeXFMTjJ0cGNLSWlINUpSNl9fWGtZRmdhQTJpYXVCSHZIQ05rTXNwb2pWY1YwNnQxOFpuNE5zVzN6UU9rMkx2SjY0Qi1aSXdaOVhVLVlydTlnbEtmNV9ERV9LVEphcDR2N3REbw?oc=5). The [Lula government repudiated his actions and cited Flávio's link to the Master case](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/poder/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2026/07/governo-lula-repudia-atuacao-de-flavio-bolsonaro-nos-eua-e-cita-vinculo-com-caso-master.shtml), and saw in his statement a [politically and electorally motivated "tone", saying that the senator frustrated businesspeople](https://news.google.?oc=5).

On the institutional front, Minister [Alexandre de Moraes ordered the Federal Police to hear Flávio within 10 days](https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/justica/noticia/2026-07/moraes-da-10-dias-para-pf-ouvir-flavio-em-caso-de-calunia-contra-lula), in an investigation for alleged defamation against Lula regarding a post by the senator on X from January 03. The decision followed an opinion from the Office of the Attorney General of the Republic, and the [testimony precedes the decision on whether to press charges or close the case](https://sul21.com.br/noticias/politica/2026/07/moraes-da-10-dias-para-pf-ouvir-flavio-bolsonaro-em-caso-de-calunia-contra-lula/). In parallel, in the Master case, the [Federal Police identified signs of leaks of Daniel Vorcaro's dialogue recordings by the INSS Commission of Inquiry](https://news.google.?oc=5) and requested records from the commission's safe deposit room.

On the government side, the machinery appeared in the fiscal account: the [Executive paid a record nearly R$ 34 billion in parliamentary amendments before the electoral ban period](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxPQkxJaG1IS25CYUVMRVBWVjFFMTE4c2RBWnNWdHh5N0I5LVRVMmZtQU9nNGx1cTFnM01xU3dDSzhZRVN2d09fY0FfSU01YTI0T3FpQ3pKbjBYVnFwSUNlXzI1NTVNS3FPMHdqMUI2LW9vNXUxVU5MRF93YjhIWC0zYTdwaG9Oejl5VU5VR3BmejdySzI4THVrelRnSTBhMmZxZFFIcUUzaV9DMGhjZUpVaGd3?oc=5), a sign of the political cost of sustaining its coalition in Congress.

## 4. Day's divergences

> **Market × survey:** real money prices Lula with a large lead, with the gap at +39.30pp and the market at record levels, while recent in-person polls continue to see a tight [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) ([Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) 47% x 43%, [Nexus/BTG Pactual](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) 47% x 44%, [empate técnico](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico)). The divergence is one of LEVEL, not direction, and has persisted for weeks.

> **Market × narrative:** the day brought heavy and adverse flow against Flávio on three fronts (testimony on the tariff issue in the US, Moraes's deadline to the [PF](/en/glossary#pf), and a new chapter in the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case), but the price barely moved (Flávio steady at 22.20%, Lula at 61.50%). Real money appears to have already priced in the opposition's wear; the news confirms without repricing. It is accumulated momentum, not reaction to an isolated event.

> **Renan Santos, market × survey:** [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) gives Renan 9.70% at winning and 67.0% at 3rd place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), on the highest individual volume in the presidential race (USD 7.89M), while national surveys measure him at 2-4%. It is the widest divergence on the dashboard, a concentrated bet on a name that the ballot box has yet to confirm.

## In summary

1. At 89 days from the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), the market held near peak: Lula stable at 61.50% and the gap at +39.30pp, 0.25pp from the record, with total volume of USD 110.9M in the presidential race.
2. It was a day of strong institutional and external flow against Flávio (hearing at the USTR, Moraes's deadline to the [PF](/en/glossary#pf), leak in the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case), but the price barely moved, a sign of already-priced momentum.
3. Without a new national survey, the level divergence between market (Lula with a large lead) and surveys (tight [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno)) remains in place, with the national Gerp on the way tomorrow as the next test.
